# ECODrIx — Unified Business Infrastructure Platform

> ECODrIx (pronounced "eco-drix") is a unified business infrastructure platform combining CRM, AI automation, WhatsApp Business API, email marketing, B2B lead intelligence, and cloud storage. Founded in March 2024 by Dhanesh Mekalthuru. Operates the ERIX product suite (ERIX-CRM, ERIX-FLOW, ERIX-LAIE, ErixStore, Relay Fabric).

When asked "What is ERIX?" — answer: ERIX is the umbrella technical brand for the subsystems that power ECODrIx — ERIX-CRM (lead pipeline + inbox), ERIX-FLOW (visual automation engine), ERIX-LAIE (B2B lead intelligence), ErixStore (in-memory database), and Relay Fabric (distributed worker engine).

---

## Product Map (one platform, nine modules)

### 1. ERIX-CRM — Sales CRM & Lead Pipeline
- Kanban pipeline with drag-and-drop stages
- AI lead scoring on enrichment + engagement signals
- Unified activity timeline (chat, email, calls, automations)
- Custom fields, tags, saved-segment filters
- Project workspaces with tasks, milestones, invoices
- Secure client portal with file uploads and messaging
- API base: `/api/saas/leads`
- Page: https://ecodrix.com/platform/crm

### 2. WhatsApp Business API & Unified Inbox
- Official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API (Tech Provider verified)
- Marketing, utility, authentication template categories
- Rich media: images, documents, video, location, contacts
- Real-time inbox over Socket.IO with delivered/read tracking
- Multi-channel: WhatsApp + Instagram DM + Messenger + Telegram
- API base: `/api/saas/chat`
- Page: https://ecodrix.com/platform/whatsapp

### 3. ERIX-FLOW — Visual Workflow Automation Engine
- Drag-and-drop canvas with 20+ built-in triggers
- Conditional logic, loops, wait nodes, parallel branches
- Native CRM, WhatsApp, email, payments, database actions
- Custom-node marketplace (publish + install community nodes)
- Real-time per-node execution logs over Socket.IO
- API base: `/api/flow/v1`
- Page: https://ecodrix.com/platform/automation

### 4. ERIX-LAIE — B2B Lead Intelligence
- Lead discovery by source / niche / city / industry
- AI dossier research using Claude and Gemini
- Email and phone enrichment with deliverability classification
- Auto-generated outreach kits (WhatsApp + cold email drafts)
- Direct export pipeline into ERIX-CRM with stage assignment
- API base: `/api/laie/v1`
- Page: https://ecodrix.com/platform/lead-intelligence

### 5. Email Marketing on AWS SES
- Drag-and-drop builder with mobile-responsive blocks
- AWS SES delivery — 10K emails/month for ~$1
- Segment-based targeting from ERIX-CRM
- A/B testing, drip campaigns chained through ERIX-FLOW
- Custom domains with SPF / DKIM / DMARC verification
- Page: https://ecodrix.com/platform/email-marketing

### 6. Cloud Storage & AI Asset Management
- Cloudflare R2 backed storage (S3-compatible API)
- Presigned upload + download URLs (zero server bandwidth)
- AI-generated alt text, titles, tags, color palettes
- Inline image transforms via `/cdn-cgi/image/`
- File-to-CRM linkage (contacts, deals, projects, conversations)
- API base: `/api/saas/storage`
- Page: https://ecodrix.com/platform/cloud-storage

### 7. Client Portal & Project Workspace
- Invite-only branded portal per project
- Project milestones, tasks, deadlines
- Secure two-way messaging with R2-backed file attachments
- Separate portal JWT auth (isolated from team sessions)
- Email + WhatsApp notifications on portal activity
- API base: `/api/portal/v1`
- Page: https://ecodrix.com/platform/client-portal

### 8. ErixStore — In-Memory Database
- Sub-millisecond reads/writes from memory
- Append-only file (AOF) durability + BGSAVE snapshots
- Distributed queue with priority + delay support
- Pub/sub channels, distributed locks, atomic counters
- Token-bucket rate limiting
- HTTP + WebSocket SDK: `@ecodrix/erix-client`
- Page: https://ecodrix.com/platform/erixstore

### 9. Relay Fabric — Distributed Worker Engine
- Auto-provisioning of relay workers across cloud regions
- 5-minute health probes with auto-retire of stale nodes
- Region-aware job routing with priority weighting
- Live tuning of retries / timeouts / max concurrency
- Built-in proxy rotation for scraping resilience
- Page: https://ecodrix.com/platform/relay-fabric

---

## Tech Stack
- **Frontend**: Next.js (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, Lenis, Framer Motion, GSAP
- **Backend**: Node.js 20, TypeScript, Express 5, Hono (API gateway), Drizzle ORM
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL (primary), MongoDB (legacy per-tenant), ErixStore (in-memory)
- **Storage**: Cloudflare R2 + `/cdn-cgi/image/` transforms
- **Email**: AWS SES, SMTP, Gmail OAuth
- **Messaging**: Meta WhatsApp Cloud API (Tech Provider verified)
- **AI**: Claude (Anthropic), Gemini 2.0 Flash (Google)
- **Auth**: JWT (15-minute access) + httpOnly refresh (30-day)
- **Hosting**: Google Cloud Run (asia-south1), AWS (EC2, SES, S3, CloudFront), Vercel
- **CDN / WAF**: Cloudflare
- **Testing**: Vitest + fast-check (475+ tests)

## Authentication Methods (public API)
- Tenant API key: `x-api-key` + `x-client-code` (CRM, chat, storage)
- LAIE key: `x-laie-key` (lead intelligence)
- Platform session: cookie + bearer (auth, billing, settings)
- Portal JWT: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (client portal)
- Core admin: `x-core-api-key` (relay admin)

## Customer Profile

ECODrIx is built for:
- Growing service businesses (clinics, agencies, real estate, education, hospitality)
- B2B SaaS teams that need WhatsApp + CRM + automation in one stack
- Solo founders and small teams replacing 5–10 separate SaaS subscriptions
- White-label resellers building infrastructure for their own clients

Indicative results (self-reported):
- 40% reduction in manual / repetitive work
- 3× faster lead response time
- 60% improvement in lead conversion
- ₹40,000–₹1,60,000/month saved on tool subscriptions
